data_fields.name: shop_price_multiplier
data_fields.donor_constant: fPriceMultiplier per house, float (data file not read)

data_fields.name: party_reputation_term
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 per hired-NPC profession present (x5 professions) plus location reputation (location value not read)

best_idea: A shop price is one multiplier of the item value, a skill percent that discounts it, a floor at the item value for buying, and a clamp to 1..value for selling, so no shop can undercut or over-pay the item's own worth.
decision_why: The clamps and the percent-off shape fit a shop as zone data; the reputation term is dropped unless Frankendom has a reputation to feed it, since the duel has none.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a shop's buy price is never below the item value, its sell price is never above the item value and never below 1, and a broken item sells for 1.
